THIS PETITION SETTING ASIDE THE CONDITION NO. 6 IN C.C.

 AGAINST THE ACCUSED NO.1 AND ETC.
 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC-D:8563  CRL.P No. 101896 of 2025 HC-KAR  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VENKATESH NAIK T)
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal of the criminal petition.

Memo which is placed on record reads as under:
MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL Herein the Advocate for the petitioners submits as under.
That the petitioner prays before the Hon'ble court dispose of this case as not pressed with liberty to file fresh case.
In view of the memo, the criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.
In view of the dismissal of the petition, pending I.A's, if any, stand disposed off.

Sd/-
(VENKATESH NAIK T) JUDGE AC /CT-AN Iranna S/O Ningappa Belliwali vs The State Of Karnataka on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84125492/
